subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Toni Morrison was a celebrated novelist.
• She is best known for her novels.
• Morrison's most famous novels include The Bluest Eye (1970) and Beloved (1987).
• Her first published work of fiction was a short story called "The Bird in the House."
• It was published in a university literary magazine in 1952.
prompt: The student wants to provide a specific example of one of Toni Morrison's most famous works. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Toni Morrison was a celebrated novelist known for her novels.
choices.B: "The Bird in the House" was published before some of Toni Morrison's most famous novels.
choices.C: The 1987 novel Beloved is one of Toni Morrison's most famous works.
choices.D: Toni Morrison's first published work of fiction was a 1952 short story called "The Bird in the House."

explanation: Choice C is the best answer because it directly accomplishes the stated goal of providing a specific example of one of Morrison's most famous works. The sentence names a particular title, Beloved, published in 1987, and explicitly identifies it as 'one of Toni Morrison's most famous works.' This directly corresponds to information in the notes stating that 'Morrison's most famous novels include The Bluest Eye (1970) and Beloved (1987).' By selecting from this category and providing the specific title with its publication year, the sentence effectively demonstrates Morrison's acclaimed literary achievement with a concrete example.
